height._why: overall = hook + headroom(cap); column = overall - runway depth - rail - 0.25 top plate. Headroom fitted on 29213/29354/29331/28640. 10 t kept at 4' (not below 5 t) — conservative per review.

builtUpShortColumn._why: Tuned 11/20 (overnight): 10 t built-up columns ≤ 17' long sold at 55 plf (29354, 15.25' columns); taller 10 t stays 70 plf (29331 mixed 57/85 plf at 20'). Sold engineered sizes, so not below the column limit.

paint._why: Template note: a full booth run = 16 beams < 18in tall and < 30 ft. Unit = ceil(length/30) per piece; runs = ceil(units/16 to 0.5), min 1; custom color min 1 full run.

sizeTaper._why: Wide calibration round 3 (docs/round3/TUNING.md): crane shop $ built/sold median 1.19 on bridge jobs with > $100k of material (n=7) and 0.92-1.0 below; big jobs carry fewer shop hours per SMT op. Shop hours x 1 up to $100k material sell, straight line to x 0.80 at $200k, flat after. Freestanding + bridge only.

travel._notes: localMaxDriveHrs: one-way drive time (site driveMinutes, else miles ÷ driveMph) at or under this commutes daily; over it the crew stays (hotel + per diem). Away crews work Mon–Sat (workDaysPerWeekAway 6); Sunday is off but still paid (hotel + per diem). Over flyAboveDriveHrs of driving the crew flies and the job box ships. airfareMultiplier: searched 2-weeks-out round-trip fare × this (late booking reality; SMT Travel Costs used 1.75), then the travel markup. flightPerMan is the fallback when no fare was searched ($400 typical fare × 2.2; the travel markup is added on top, same as a searched fare).

pmCad._why: Tuned 11/20 (overnight): PM + CAD $ = 226.5 × (materials + shop $ in $k)^0.807, fitted log-log on sold crane jobs 29213, 28426, 29140, 28192 (ex-gantries), 29562, 29354, 28772, 29331, 28723 — big jobs carry a smaller share (12% at $30k, 6% at $1.6M). Split 48% PM / 52% CAD at the template's $95 / $120 rates. Replaces the linear 5.2 / 4.5 h per $10k.

bracing._why: Tuned 11/20 (overnight): tube-column FSTR gets ST3x3 tie-back bracing from 8 columns or ≥3 t. 28640 (6 columns, 2 t) sold without bracing; 29140 (8 columns, 2 t) sold with it.

boxGirder._why: Added 11/20 (overnight). Past the AQT girder chart the girder is sized at L/600 (rated load + hoist, plus self weight) as the lightest W shape up to 36" deep; when none works, a plate box girder: depth = span/24 (24-48"), two 1/4" webs, flanges for the required I, x1.15 for diaphragms/rail/stiffeners. Calibrated on 29562 (70' 10 t, 189 plf sold) and 28723 (75' 15 t double girder, 161 plf sold). Box fab 1.8 SMT h/ft (both jobs). 11/27: max depth 48" → 96" so long spans (100'+) get a deep box instead of very heavy flanges (28421: 150' 60 t).

classD._why: Added 11/20 (overnight): Class D (heavy service) sold jobs carry a hoist one size up, derated — 29562 (10 t bridge, SMW 15 t hoists, 10 h 'auto derating' shop time) and 28723 (10 t on STW 15 t, 15 t on STW 20 t).
